accessBasis.gate: CreateAccessService.resolveRegisterCreateAccess(VoucherRegisterType.receipt): the voucher_creation_mobile feature first (fail-closed on lookup error), then AccessControlService.canCreateInCurrentCompanyRegister for the Receipts register.

behaviourReviewed: Bill allocation card is rendered only when !isEditing; an existing receipt opens as Edit Receipt with no picker.
Select Invoices offers Unpaid / Partial / Paid / All chips plus a voucher-number search, and shows each invoice's remaining balance.
ReceiptBillAllocation links a receipt to a sales invoice via paysathi_bill (Agst Ref); leaving the picker empty leaves the receipt On Account.
Save is disabled until a bank ledger is chosen (onPressed is null when selectedBankLedgerId == null).
Validation messages: Amount must be greater than 0; Please select mode of payment.
DuplicateVoucherDialog fires on a same-party same-amount same-day match and offers Create anyway.
BankSelectionList's UPI action is opt-in and switched on for receipts only (money in); create_payment_screen deliberately leaves it off.
The read-only 'Against invoice' row appears in the payment-mode-only flow launched from an invoice.
